design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (vehicle_purchase_deals) — round 8 (seed only, S2): the four points-earned rows and rewards_points_balance re-priced by the published service rules (376/1034/272/756 -> 470/1292/590/1195; 2438 -> 3547); no read of this task uses points, so no scored value, baseline or sensitivity moves. Round 5: R4-1 — the credit cap now sits in the baseline paragraph and acts on the requirement before shares; no figure of this task changes (cap 0.6 x 2269.575 = 1361.75 never binds here: credited 0, or 1000.00 under the credit factor's baseline). Round 4: T1-3 (deposit_received_record tier_taken now 'at least resv_mid_ratio and less than resv_high_ratio of cash_price'; every tier_taken/factor_trace swept) and R1 (money rounding RND(x + 0.000000001, 2)). The vehicle's cash_price moved from 41260.00 to 41265.00 so that no scored, baseline or factor-sensitivity figure, and no rounding argument, sits within 1e-6 of a half cent (closest 0.00125); every tier and the 7-day extension are unchanged, the deposit is 1940.49. The extension-deposit rule's standard method (round 5, in its computation paragraph) caps the deposits credited at max_credit_share (0.6) of the extension deposit required (rate times cash_price, before any share), so something is always owed (the smallest share product 0.90 x 0.85 = 0.765 exceeds 0.6) (the 250.00 minimum never creates an amount on nothing owed); here nothing is credited, so the cap does not bind. Round 3: N3 scope sync only, values unchanged (1940.49 / 7). Round 2 (audit items C1, C2b, C5, C9a/b/d, T1-1, T1-2 closed).

0. DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,4]. purchase_ext_extension_deposit 6, purchase_ext_hold_extension_days 4.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. A retail buyer asks the desk to extend the hold on her reserved RAV4 Hybrid once. The extension rule states its days are not worked out until a deposit received on the handling date stands on the deal; her deal holds only the 1000.00 credit-card deposit of 2026-10-20. The extension-deposit rule (non-fleet deals) sets that deposit — six factors: rewards tier rate, returned-check rate, hold-timing rate, service-spend share, deposit-received share and which deposits are credited — and it is the buyer's own write (debit card) on hand-over. The extension days are then computed (four factors: deposit cover, service visits, tenure, starting-day method) on the world the deposit created; without it the cover tier is none and the extension is 6 days, not 7.

2. SCOPE. Claims purchase_ext_extension_deposit and purchase_ext_hold_extension_days, tools pay_extension_deposit_9124466d (user) and extend_vehicle_hold_21e7c68f (agent). Both scoped to every deal type other than Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement; task 0 holds the four fleet policies.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root purchase_ext_hold_extension_days (agent). Edge -> purchase_ext_extension_deposit: value_input on deposit_cover_days, form state, sentence (negated): "The extension days are not worked out until a deposit received on the handling date stands on the deal." (C2b: a record test — a purchase_deposit_received row dated the handling date — no other policy's amount is evaluated.) Opening evidence: the deal's only deposit row is dated 2026-10-20; handling date 2026-10-21. Among this difficulty's rules only the extension-deposit rule (non-fleet) books a deposit for a hold; the fleet order deposit is fleet-only. N3 (round 3): both extension policies now cover only a hold extension asked for on a day after the reserved_date (a request on the reservation date keeps the base extension and no deposit), and the extension-deposit rule states that on such a deal a deposit the buyer adds on a day after the reserved_date is the extension deposit; so the waited-on record (a deposit dated the handling date) can only be the extension deposit. Here the deal was reserved 2026-10-20 and the request is 2026-10-21: in scope. Deletion sensitivity: skipping the deposit gives 6 days and no deposit row. Tools validate nothing about the prerequisite.
 C1/T1-2: the base sentence "Extensions carry no fee and leave the deposit unchanged." is now overwritten by the extension-deposit rule: "For a reserved deal of any deal type other than Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement whose hold extension is asked for on a day after its reserved_date a hold extension carries no fee, and the buyer adds the extension deposit this policy sets, which is held against the deal like any other deposit, and only for such a deal; for a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement, and for a hold extension asked for on the deal's reserved_date, a hold extension carries no fee and leaves the deposit unchanged." No in-force base sentence now supports a no-deposit reading.
 T1-1: the hold-extension rule states "Each request a buyer makes is handled as one extension of the hold; a further extension needs a further request.", and the buyer asks for one extension (and declines a second if offered), so exactly one extension write is entailed.

4. FACTOR CARD.
 extension deposit (1940.49; whole baseline 1063.25):
  rewards_tier_rate [param, X service]: Gold active -> 0.04; baseline 0.05 -> 2293.30.
  returned_bank_payment_rate [param, X service]: one returned check (RO 517903, 2025-12-18) in 24 whole months -> +0.01; baseline -> 1587.67.
  hold_time_left_rate [param]: 4 days to 2026-10-25 -> +0.005; baseline -> 1764.08.
  service_spend_record [param, X service]: customer-pay labor+parts in 12 whole months 1031.41 (RO 512248 of 2025-09-14 is 13 months back) -> 0.90; baseline -> 2156.10.
  deposit_received_record [param]: deposits received 1000.00 = 2.42% of 41265.00 -> 0.95; baseline -> 2042.62.
  deposit_funds_credit [method]: card deposit on the deal -> credited 1000.00 - 1000.00 = 0.00; baseline whole deposit held -> 940.49.
  Assembly: 0.055 * 41265.00 = 2269.575 * 0.90 * 0.95 = 1940.486625 - 0.00, above the 250.00 minimum -> 1940.49 (half up).
 extension days (7; whole baseline 3):
  deposit_cover [param, multi-source]: 2940.49 = 7.13% of 41265.00 (>= 5%, < 7.5%) AND a debit-card deposit held -> +1; baseline -> 6.
  service_visit_record [param, X service]: 3 customer-pay line-A repair orders in 12 whole months -> +1; baseline -> 6.
  service_tenure_days [param, X service]: opened 2018-05-14, 101 whole months -> +1; baseline -> 6.
  extension_start_day [method] (C5): expiry 2026-10-25 is a Sunday (weekday index 6) -> start the following Monday, offset 7 - weekday = 1 (a Saturday expiry gives 2: the offset reads the weekday, so the weekend tier and the fall-through differ by an input, not a constant); baseline 0 -> 6.
  Assembly: length 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 6 from Monday 2026-10-26 -> new expiry 2026-11-01, 7 days after 2026-10-25.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Deposit: deal_open_for_deposit holds (reserved); total 2940.49 <= deposit_max_usd 10000; debit_card allowed; credit-card deposits 1000.00 <= 5000. Extension: reserved_for_extension holds; count 0 < max_hold_extensions 2; counted from the current expiry, never from the request date.

6. BUSINESS OBJECT / SEED. One reserved deal KTD-26-11432 with one credit-card deposit. Service account SA-148730 (Gold, opened 2018-05-14), four repair orders on the 2017 Camry: RO 512248 (2025-09-14), RO 517903 (2025-12-09; check returned 2025-12-18 with a 30.00 returned-payment fee; repaid 2025-12-22 by debit card), RO 521577 (2026-04-16), RO 525014 (2026-08-11); Owner Rewards points credited by the published service rules on each crediting date (round 8, S2: 2 per whole dollar of labor and parts, x 1.25 tenure multiplier for a Gold account open 60+ whole months, fraction dropped, + 250 frequent-visit bonus from the 3rd payment in 12 whole months: 470, 1292, 590, 1195; balance 3547, nothing redeemed or expired); open_balance 0.00 = ledger; Gold holds at the 2026-05-14 review (841.54 >= 750). No automatic clause fires.

7. PERSONA. Volunteers the goal (one extension, desk acts) and the situation (credit union loan into next week, hold ends Sunday); identity, deal number, financing and delivery on request; agrees to what must be done first only after the agent says so, pays the amount handed over by debit card; declines a second extension or anything else; ends on the new hold date.

8. STANDARD SOLUTION. Reads: customer (phone), verify (phone + license last four), deal, transactions, service account, RO lines, vehicles, store. Writes: user debit-card deposit 1940.49, then one extension of 7 days (2026-11-01). verify.py replays the deposit through the real tool before evaluating the extension; edge skip gives 6.

9. DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The extension rule's sentence asks for a deposit received today; the extension-deposit rule sets it (card deposit not credited); the buyer pays it; one extension of 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 days from the Monday after the Sunday expiry: 7.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Delgado, a middle-school science teacher in Centerville, Ohio, calling the Kessler support desk on your planning period on a Wednesday afternoon. You are organized, polite and a little anxious about losing the car. Yesterday you reserved a new 2026 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid at Kessler Toyota of Dayton and put a 1,000 dollar reservation deposit on your credit card. Your credit union is still working on your auto loan and has told you it needs into next week, and the hold on the RAV4 runs out this Sunday. You want the hold on that RAV4 extended once, enough to carry you into next week, and you are asking the desk to do it for you today. Only when the agent asks, you confirm your phone number, 9375551236, and the last four of your driver's license, 1418; if a third detail is wanted, your ZIP code is 45459 and your email is marisol.delgado@outlook.com. If the agent asks which reservation, you read the deal number off your reservation email, KTD-26-11432. If the agent asks how you are paying for the car, you say your credit union is financing it, and that the delivery to your house is already set up on the reservation. You do not know the store's rules for extensions and you do not suggest any. If the agent explains that something has to be done before the hold can be extended, you agree, and when the agent tells you an amount and hands you the payment to make, you pay exactly that amount yourself with your debit card on the RAV4 reservation and read back the receipt. If asked whether you would rather use your credit card, you say no, the debit card. Once the agent tells you the new last day of the hold, you repeat the date back, thank them and end the call. If the agent offers anything else, including a second extension, you politely decline.

edges.condition: the deal's purchase_transactions include a purchase_deposit_received row whose txn_date is the handling date, which is later than the deal's reserved_date (on such a deal only the extension deposit is added after the reservation date).
edges.policy_source: The extension days are not worked out until a deposit received on the handling date stands on the deal.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The deal's only deposit was received on 2026-10-20 (the reservation date); no deposit has been received on the handling date 2026-10-21.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 9 receives the 1940.49 debit-card extension deposit dated 2026-10-21; deposit_held_balance becomes 2940.49 and the deposit-cover tier moves from none to cover_mid_days.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single chain: the extension waits on the extension deposit (value_input on deposit_cover_days); no parallel prerequisites.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the deposit leaves deposit_held_balance 1000.00 (2.4%, no collected funds): extension_days 6 instead of 7 (new expiry 2026-10-31 instead of 2026-11-01) and no deposit row.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for one extension of the hold; it never mentions a deposit. The buyer agrees to do what is needed and pays an amount only after the agent explains something must be done first and hands the payment over.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: extend_vehicle_hold_21e7c68f reads the deal only for its current hold_expires_date and count, then updates both; it never checks deposits. pay_extension_deposit_9124466d creates one deposit and updates deposit_held_balance; neither returns an error or a hint.
